title: veronica bellidioides subsp. lilacina
intro: Veronica bellidioides subsp. lilacina, commonly known as the Lilac Veronica, is a flowering plant species within the plantain family (Plantaginaceae). It is known for its medicinal properties, which offer various health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The plant's therapeutic actions include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and act as an expectorant to alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Lilac Veronica include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
